text:
Alicia Chen: Heads-up — onboarding question for Orchid Labs. They want a short ops playbook and saved log views we can point them to for their gen route (org:orchid, route:orchid-gen). Where do we keep the region+model presets for ap-sg and p95/5xx/KV-miss filters?
Sam K: We have a couple of savedviews but tbh they were split across team and platform. Which model variant are they on?
Alicia Chen: Borealis-gen-v2 (low-latency profile). Need p95 latency, 5xx count, and kv_cache_miss rate by node. Prefer shared saved searches so their SEs can re-use.
Raj Patel: I can share queries. Quick ones we use in LogSearch:

```
# p95 latency by route/org
route:orchid-gen org:orchid region:ap-sg | stats pct(95, latency_ms) by node

# 5xx count last 30m
route:orchid-gen status:[500 TO 599] region:ap-sg @timestamp:>now-30m | count

# KV cache miss rate
route:orchid-gen tag:kvcache_miss=true region:ap-sg | stats count as misses, count() as total by node | eval miss_rate = misses/total
```

Raj Patel: Those are quick snippets — we usually save them as: Orchid / ap-sg / p95-latency, Orchid / ap-sg / 5xx-rate, Orchid / ap-sg / kvcache-miss.
Zoe Li: There is a dashboard link that combines them + traces. Pinning it here: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/ops/orchid-onboard (view-only for SEs)
Marta Rivera: If you want me to create saved views in LogSearch I can. Suggested names: `orchid-ap-sg-p95`, `orchid-ap-sg-5xx`, `orchid-ap-sg-kv-miss`. Thoughts?
Alicia Chen: Great. Please create them and set retention to 90d for the saved view. Also add the query snippet in the description so SEs can copy. Can you set a default time range to 1h?
Marta Rivera: Yep — will do. I'll also add alert suggestions: p95 > 600ms for more than 5min and 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained 10m.
Sam K: For KV miss, can we add node-level spike alert (>2 stddev above 24h baseline)?
Marta Rivera: Yup, I'll wire that into the alert policy and ping @oncall for review.
OpsBot: Saved view `orchid-ap-sg-p95` created by Marta Rivera at 2024-06-22T15:12:03Z. Link: https://logsearch.redwood.internal/saved/orchid-ap-sg-p95
Alicia Chen: Awesome. Last ask — can someone add an example logsearch query to the onboarding doc under /docs/onboarding/orchid? Small copy+paste block is enough.
Raj Patel: I'll add the three snippets to the doc and include the dashboard link.
Zoe Li: I'll run a quick smoke check tomorrow morning (ap-sg) and report any anomalies. :eyes:
Alicia Chen: Thanks team — this helps for the onboarding call on Friday. If anything else pops up, drop it here.
